business_description: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated is a diversified U.S.-based healthcare company operating through health insurance benefits and health services businesses. Its UnitedHealthcare business provides commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and other health benefit plans. Its Optum businesses provide care delivery, pharmacy benefit management and specialty pharmacy services, healthcare data/analytics, revenue cycle, technology, consulting, and other services to payers, providers, employers, governments, and consumers.
business_model: UnitedHealth combines a large-scale managed care insurer with vertically integrated healthcare services assets. The company earns premiums and administrative fees from health benefit plans, pharmacy and care delivery revenue through Optum, and technology, analytics, and services fees through Optum Insight. Economic performance depends on membership growth, premium pricing versus medical cost trend, government reimbursement rates, pharmacy spread/rebate economics, care delivery capacity and utilization, and execution across regulated healthcare markets.
